description: [Company & tax] Confirm that a company exists, is active and is who it claims to be before onboarding, invoicing or contracting. Use when you need an official registry record for a counterparty. Price: $0.02 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/company-lookup

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. GB, NO, DK, US

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

query.description: Company name, LEI or registry number (auto-detected)

registration_number.description: National registry number, e.g. UK company number or Norwegian org.nr

name: lookup_company
title: Company Lookup (GLEIF LEI, UK, Norway) ($0.02)
